name: thermal-and-dynamic
description: Thermal conditions (temperature, convection, heat flux) and dynamic absorbing/quiet boundaries that prevent reflection of outgoing waves in dynamic analyses.
verification: All thermal and dynamic keywords are visible in the live 9.7 enumerations even WITHOUT 'model configure thermal/dynamic' — the configure gate applies at execution, not keyword visibility.
Thermal keywords sit on 'block face apply' (convection, flux) and 'block gridpoint apply' (temperature), matching the placement documented here.
notes: 'block gridpoint apply temperature ...' fixes temperature; 'block face apply convection ...' sets film coefficient.
Viscous (quiet) gridpoint boundaries absorb outgoing waves in dynamic runs.
Both 'quiet(-x/y/z)' and 'viscous(-x/y/z)' exist as separate live keyword families on 'block gridpoint apply'.
